COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

2. Which statement about Leadership Development is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Leadership Development never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Leadership Development.
   C. Explain Leadership Development with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Leadership Development as rumours only.

3. Which statement about Civic Dialogue 1.2 Advocacy in the Community 1.3 Leadership Development 1.4 Inte is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Civic Dialogue 1.2 Advocacy in the Community 1.3 Leadership Development 1.4 Inte never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Civic Dialogue 1.2 Advocacy in the Community 1.3 Leadership Development 1.4 Inte.
   C. Explain Civic Dialogue 1.2 Advocacy in the Community 1.3 Leadership Development 1.4 Inte with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Civic Dialogue 1.2 Advocacy in the Community 1.3 Leadership Development 1.4 Inte as rumours only.

4. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

5. Which statement about Building Consensus is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Building Consensus with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Building Consensus never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Building Consensus.
   D. Treat Building Consensus as rumours only.

6. Which statement about Intercultural Competence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Intercultural Competence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Intercultural Competence never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Intercultural Competence as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Intercultural Competence.

7. Which statement about Nurturing Empathy 2.2 Negotiation Skills 2.3 Building Consensus 3.0 Action Resea is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Nurturing Empathy 2.2 Negotiation Skills 2.3 Building Consensus 3.0 Action Resea as rumours only.
   B. Say Nurturing Empathy 2.2 Negotiation Skills 2.3 Building Consensus 3.0 Action Resea never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Nurturing Empathy 2.2 Negotiation Skills 2.3 Building Consensus 3.0 Action Resea with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Nurturing Empathy 2.2 Negotiation Skills 2.3 Building Consensus 3.0 Action Resea.

8. Which statement about Negotiation Skills is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Negotiation Skills as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Negotiation Skills.
   C. Say Negotiation Skills never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Negotiation Skills with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about Civic Dialogue is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Civic Dialogue as rumours only.
   B. Say Civic Dialogue never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Civic Dialogue with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Civic Dialogue.

10. Which statement about Advocacy in the School Community is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Advocacy in the School Community.
   B. Explain Advocacy in the School Community with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Advocacy in the School Community as rumours only.
   D. Say Advocacy in the School Community never happens in Kenya.

11. Which statement about Problem Identification Process 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entr is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Problem Identification Process 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entr as rumours only.
   B. Say Problem Identification Process 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entr never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Problem Identification Process 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entr.
   D. Explain Problem Identification Process 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entr with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Littering in markets

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Civic Dialogue and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Advocacy in the School Community and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Leadership Development 1.4 Intercultural Competence 2.0 Life Skills Education 2. and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Leadership Development and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

9. C — Explain Civic Dialogue with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Civic Dialogue; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Advocacy in the School Community; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Leadership Development 1.4 Intercultural Competence 2.0 Life Skills Education 2.; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Leadership Development; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
